title: Pullback compatibility of compatible exact comparison presentations
statement: For a morphism g:Y→X of schemes [def-pc-scheme], quasi-coherent modules F and G [pqf-def-coherent], an abelian h-map induced by φ:F→g_*G [def-pbc-qcoherent-zariski-cohomology-map], and a map θ:F_et→g_*G_et, let D_X,D_Y be exact comparison presentations [def-pbc-coherent-etale-exact-comparison]. If an isomorphism P_X⋙E≅Z⋙P_Y intertwines the canonical constant-integer maps and the adjoint coefficient maps, then the explicit Ext comparison maps commute with the Zariski h-map and etale pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] in every degree. No compactness, separatedness, normalized equivalence families, or section formula for θ is required.

proof.text: Use the proved source Ext.mapExactFunctor_mapExactFunctor_of_iso twice (once for the identity isomorphism) and cancel the inverse components. This gives naturality of the iterated exact-functor Ext maps under tau. The private helper exact_functor_square implements this directly.

Precompose with the integer map and postcompose with the coefficient map. Expand preservation of Ext composition and degree-zero maps, associate, and substitute the two supplied triangles. The private exact_functor_square_coefficients carries out this algebra.

The explicit comparison maps and the two pullback maps evaluate definitionally to the two Ext expressions just proved equal. Use that identity directly, with no equality transports rewriting the bundled maps. This API caches their large definitional conversion for the original normalized theorem.

theorem exactComparison_hmap_square
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward g).obj G)
    (θ : liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F ⟶
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G))
    (D₁ : CoherentEtale.ExactComparison X) (D₂ : CoherentEtale.ExactComparison Y) :
    let J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X
    let K := Opens.grothendieckTopology Y
    let Z := (Opens.map g.base).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K
    let z := ((Opens.map g.base).constantSheafsheafPullbackIso AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K
      isTerminalTop isTerminalTop).symm.app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
    let f := (((Opens.map g.base).sheafAdjunctionContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K).homEquiv
      _ _).symm (moduleAbelianHMap g φ)
    let E := Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g
    let e := (Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).symm.app
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
    let t := ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).homEquiv
      (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G)).symm θ
    ∀ (τ : D₁.P ⋙ E ≅ Z ⋙ D₂.P),
      e.hom ≫ E.map D₁.integer ≫ τ.hom.app (CoherentEtale.zariskiInteger X) =
        D₂.integer ≫ D₂.P.map z.hom →
      τ.hom.app ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) ≫
          D₂.P.map f ≫ D₂.coefficient G = E.map (D₁.coefficient F) ≫ t →
      ∀ (q : ℕ) (x : CoherentEtale.Source X F q),
        D₂.map G q (zariskiModuleHMap g φ q x) =
          Sheaf.H.map t q
            (Etale.cohomologyMap g (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) q (D₁.map F q x))
